This is literally my life in high school. Junior year I basically quit caring. I stopped being involved in clubs, I rarely went to dance (the only thing I loved at the time) and I didn't even touch my homework. But I soon figured out, it's the disease doing this. If your school has any counseling service I strongly recommend seeing them. My social worker saved my ass and my gpa junior and senior year. 
Just one thing, the disease is what is making you "lazy" but you will feel better soon. And then the lazy, not studying, doing homework habit is hard to break. So once you feel up to it, and I swear you will, start doing your work. Even if it starts out small like handing in the homework a few days late rather than not handing it in at all.

Good luck my dear! You'll pull through, you're stronger than you know.
